desc:
💀 - Story driven retro horror game. 

⚰️ - Use your crucifix to interact with the world.

📜 - Enjoy playing STORY CHAPTER 1 and STORY CHAPTER 2 with a total of 4 ENDINGS.

🔵 - Play the game to earn SOULS and unlock new CLASSES (PREMIUM players earn 20% bonus souls).

"In some religions, an exorcist is a person who is believed to be able to perform the ridding of demons, ghosts or other supernatural beings who are alleged to have possessed someone or something."

HIT the 👍 LIKE and 🔔  FOLLOW button for new update!
Experience based on Faith videogame and The Exorcist movie.
